tests.name: Ridge Regression: Training fit & LOOCV execution
tests.expected: R² > 0.99, LOOCV RMSE < 0.05 mg/L
tests.actual: Train R² = 0.9996, Train RMSE = 0.0076 mg/L, LOOCV RMSE = 0.0193 mg/L
tests.evidence: Features = 151 wavelengths, Standards = 21 runs (7 concs × 3 replicates)

tests.name: Cross-Validation Leakage Audit: Replicate contamination in LOOCV
tests.expected: Leave-One-Concentration-Out (Group CV) required when multiple replicates exist
tests.actual: Standard LOOCV splits individual sample replicates (21 samples total, 3 per concentration). When sample i is left out, 2 identical target concentration samples remain in the training fold.
tests.evidence: In demoData.ts line 38, generatePhosphateCalibrationStandards produces 3 replicates per conc. In ridge.ts line 157, LOOCV leaves out 1 sample out of 21. Reported LOOCV RMSE (0.0193 mg/L) is overly optimistic due to replicate leakage.

tests.name: Model Selection: Objective selection based on LOOCV RMSE (not biased towards AI)
tests.expected: Selects lower LOOCV RMSE regardless of model architecture (can select Beer-Lambert)
tests.actual: When Beer has lower LOOCV -> selected: beer-lambert; When Ridge has lower -> selected: ridge
tests.evidence: Model selection relies purely on loocvRmse comparison (ridgeMetrics.loocvRmse < beerMetrics.loocvRmse)

tests.name: Uncertainty Inflation for OOD and Range Edge Samples
tests.expected: Uncertainty increases for OOD and range edges
tests.evidence: OOD inflation factor: 1.0 + (ood - 1.8)*0.8; Edge penalty: 1.35x

tests.name: Uncertainty: Sample-level shot noise sensitivity
tests.expected: Higher sensor shot noise should expand predictive confidence interval
tests.actual: Clean noise (OOD 0.8): ±0.038 mg/L; Elevated noise (OOD 1.2): ±0.038 mg/L (IDENTICAL)
tests.evidence: CRITICAL AUDIT FINDING: Base standard error is fixed to LOOCV RMSE (Math.max(0.015, loocvRmse)). It does NOT incorporate sample-specific spectral residual variance or SNR. Only OOD distance > 1.8 triggers inflation.

bugs.reproduction: Select 'Total Iron' in the header dropdown and click [CAPTURE & ANALYSE].
bugs.expected: Pipeline loads iron calibration standards, uses 500-525 nm band, and predicts iron concentration.
bugs.actual: Pipeline hardcodes `const analyte = ANALYTE_REGISTRY[0]` (Phosphate) and executes phosphate calibration across 630-690 nm band while labeling output with Iron units.
bugs.evidence: Line 101 of orchestrator.ts: `const analyte = ANALYTE_REGISTRY[0]; // Phosphate as primary`. PipelineExecutionOptions does not even accept an analyte parameter.
bugs.likelyCause: Phosphate was implemented as the single demo analyte; multi-analyte orchestrator dispatch was left stubbed.
bugs.recommendedFix: Pass selected `analyteId` in `PipelineExecutionOptions` and instantiate/cache analyte-specific calibration standards.

bugs.reproduction: Open 'CALIBRATE PHONE', select Device B (Warm sensor), run fingerprinting until calibrated. Run a scan.
bugs.expected: Raw sensor intensities are divided by `device.spectralSensitivity` via `normalizeDeviceSpectrum` before computing absorbance.
bugs.actual: `normalizeDeviceSpectrum` is never called anywhere in the codebase. Results on Device B are identical whether calibrated or uncalibrated.
bugs.evidence: `grep -r normalizeDeviceSpectrum src/` returns only the definition in `deviceCalibration.ts:64`. It is dead code.
bugs.likelyCause: Device calibration UI modal was built with animated steps, but the normalization hook into `executeLISAPipeline` was omitted.

bugs.expected: Grouped Cross-Validation (Leave-One-Concentration-Out) so replicates of the same concentration are excluded together.
bugs.actual: Standard LOOCV excludes 1 replicate out of 21, leaving 2 identical-concentration replicates in the training fold.
bugs.evidence: 21 standards generated (7 concs × 3 reps). Training fold retains identical target concentrations, artificially suppressing LOOCV RMSE to 0.0193 mg/L.
bugs.likelyCause: Standard LOOCV implementation did not account for replicate grouping.
bugs.recommendedFix: Implement Leave-One-Group-Out CV grouped by target concentration.

bugs.reproduction: Run pipeline on clean standard (noiseLevel = 0.015) vs noisy standard (noiseLevel = 0.08).
bugs.evidence: Line 20 of uncertainty.ts: `let se = Math.max(0.015, loocvRmse);`. Standard error is fixed to calibration LOOCV error and ignores sample SNR.
bugs.likelyCause: Uncertainty estimator was designed around calibration variance rather than combining calibration variance with sample residual variance.
bugs.recommendedFix: Incorporate sample spectral residual variance `s_res^2 = sum(A_measured - A_reconstructed)^2 / df` into the standard error.

bugs.reproduction: Pass fewer than 2 points to `fitWavelengthCalibration` or `fitBeerLambertModel`.
bugs.expected: Return an error, throw, or return NaN R².
bugs.actual: Returns fake excellent metrics: Wavelength R² = 0.9995; Beer-Lambert R² = 0.99.
bugs.likelyCause: Premature mock fallback values inserted during initial prototyping to prevent UI crashes.
bugs.recommendedFix: Return explicit error status `isValid: false` and `r2: NaN` when points < 2.

bugs.reproduction: Select 'LIVE CAMERA' or 'HARDWARE' source mode and click [CAPTURE & ANALYSE].
bugs.expected: Camera video frame is grabbed and binned, or hardware adapter is polled.
bugs.actual: Pipeline silently ignores the camera stream and hardware adapter, running `simulateSpectrum` instead.
bugs.evidence: In App.tsx line 104: `let simData = simulateSpectrum(params); let sampleIntensities = customSampleIntensities || simData.sampleIntensities;`. Live camera does not pass customSampleIntensities.
bugs.likelyCause: Physical camera frame binning loop was not wired to the CAPTURE trigger.
bugs.recommendedFix: Render canvas frame grab from `<video ref={videoRef}>` and pass extracted profile to `onUploadSpectrumData`.

bugs.reproduction: Inspect Calibration RMSE row in Model Comparison table.
bugs.expected: Beer-Lambert RMSE shown in Absorbance Units (AU) or converted to concentration units.
bugs.actual: Displays `0.0539 mg/L` for Beer-Lambert, comparing Absorbance RMSE directly against Ridge concentration RMSE (0.0076 mg/L).
bugs.evidence: beerLambert.ts line 79 computes RMSE on `residual = pt.a - fitted` (AU). ModelComparison.tsx displays `{beerMetrics.rmse.toFixed(4)} mg/L`.
bugs.likelyCause: Unit label was copy-pasted without converting absorbance residual to concentration via division by slope.
bugs.recommendedFix: Compute concentration RMSE for Beer-Lambert: `rmse_conc = rmse_abs / slope`.

bugs.reproduction: Inspect ResultCard confidence display in DOM.
bugs.expected: Displays dynamically calculated confidence percentage from `uncertaintyEstimate.confidencePercent`.
bugs.likelyCause: Hardcoded placeholder in JSX never wired to `explanation.confidencePercent`.

bugs.reproduction: Record 5 measurements, then refresh browser (F5 / Cmd+R).
bugs.expected: Past measurement audit log persists across page reload.
bugs.actual: All measurement history is wiped clean on reload.
bugs.evidence: App.tsx line 62 uses in-memory React state: `const [history, setHistory] = useState<MeasurementRecord[]>([]);` without `localStorage` synchronization.
bugs.likelyCause: Initial prototype used ephemeral React state.

bugs.reproduction: Upload an image with a spectral band centered at Y=250.
bugs.expected: ROI vertical center accurately captures Y=250.
bugs.actual: Row variance peaks at the sharp edge transition (Y=230) rather than the center of the band (Y=250), shifting the ROI upward.
bugs.evidence: test_roi_cv.ts output: center detected at Y=230 vs true center Y=250.
bugs.likelyCause: Picks maximum single-row variance instead of centroid / center-of-mass across rows.
bugs.recommendedFix: Calculate center of mass of the top 20% variance rows.

bugs.reproduction: Open Diagnostics before running any measurement.

recommendations.action: Enable dynamic multi-analyte dispatch in executeLISAPipeline so selecting Iron/Fluoride loads their respective calibration models.
Wire normalizeDeviceSpectrum into executeLISAPipeline to eliminate dead code and make device calibration real.
Replace standard LOOCV with Grouped Leave-One-Concentration-Out to eliminate replicate leakage.
Combine calibration error with sample-specific spectral residual variance so noisy samples exhibit wider confidence bounds.
Remove hardcoded fallback R² values (0.9995, 0.99) when points < 2; return explicit error.
Wire live camera frame grab from <video> element to generate 1D profile on Capture.
Sync measurement history with localStorage so records survive page reload.
Fix Beer-Lambert calibration RMSE unit label from mg/L to AU (or convert to mg/L via slope).
Add responsive collapse menu for header buttons on mobile viewports (< 768px).
Explicitly label Shimadzu UV-Vis split-sample data as 'Simulated Benchtop Reference' rather than implying physical wet-lab trial.
